about_the_game:
Aliens are real. They're weird. And they're really good at hiding...

Welcome to the most chill alien discovery program in the galaxy, the M.C.A.D.P!

Armed with your scanner as well as a sharp eye, you will find hidden alien species while exploring iconic, hand-drawn planets just waiting to be discovered. Every world exists as a living, breathing black-and-white canvas. Upon your discovery of every life form, a splash of color returns to the scene.

Your mission? Just scan the aliens, simply color them, then bring strange planets to life slowly. No pressure, no timers! Creatures of oddball type and surprises, quite quirky, fill up a relaxing kind of adventure all across the universe.

Key Features:

Find Hidden Lifeforms: Every planet contains unique alien species cleverly hidden within the environment: discover hidden lifeforms, like adorable blob-things plus majestic space squids.

Color the Cosmos: When an alien coloring the cosmos gets scanned, discoveries turn into art filling the monochrome world.

Interactive Exploration: Tap, poke, swipe, and open things revealing what is hiding. Some aliens just love to make entrances upon arrival.

Hand-Drawn Style: Each world is created by way of detailed line-art illustrations. Every single corner of the entire cosmos gains charm and also character from out of this very style.

Relaxing Gameplay: No rush. No stress. The finding of the unexpected, lighthearted fun, and pure exploration are your goals.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 | AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 950 | AMD R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 | AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 | AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Discover strange creatures hidden across weird planets. In this hand drawn universe you need to observe and color in alien lifeforms as you explore interactive worlds full of secrets and surprises.
